suggestions.rationale: Mapping Expansion Batch ME-8 adds this relationship only as a bounded clinical proposition. Anemia is a major clinical manifestation of myelodysplastic syndromes and may arise from ineffective/dysplastic erythropoiesis. Require established myelodysplastic syndrome and separately documented anemia. Do not attribute every anemia automatically to MDS; preserve bleeding, iron/B12/folate deficiency, chronic kidney disease, hemolysis, treatment effects, inflammatory disease, and other marrow disorders. The cited literature supports only this constrained relationship and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
